description: This file defines constants, structures, and function prototypes for GDB stub debugging support in Zephyr OS, including exception codes, memory region attributes, and memory access checking functions.

methods.name: gdb_bin2hex
methods.description: Converts a binary array into a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: gdb_mem_can_read
methods.description: Checks if a memory block can be read.

methods.name: gdb_mem_can_write
methods.description: Checks if a memory block can be written into.
